claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: I-TECH: 490 patients, 21.6% vs 17.3% RR 1.25, deaths 3 vs 10 RR 0.31 match.

claims.text: Dhaka health workers [W3112738722], India health workers case-control [W3129541046], retrospective prophylaxis [W3136091706], Itajaí citywide [W4206412576] and ecological analysis [W4399761191].

claims.rationale: Each cited paper matches its description: Dhaka observational, India case-control, retrospective prophylaxis, Itajaí citywide, ecological analysis.

claims.text: **Not an original trial:** Sandhya Rani [W3213437465] reports exactly Ahmed et al.'s numbers.
claims.label: unsupported
